head_commit.message:
Validate native whole record fusion with fresh a300 corpus parity

Correctness-only study: complete native/lint/unit/options/type/build gates and fresh stock/candidate JMdict, Jitendex and VNDB imports. Preserve actual startup, complete field/scalar/final-file bytes and enclosing-owner native/copy accounting. Bind the current SQLite admission helper without changing its logic or the outer lifecycle. Keep the exact seven-path runtime delta and link-safe full evidence retention.

No browser or comparative timing acquisition, readiness forcing, replacement observations or PR qualification. Earlier f28 studies remain immutable and rejected. The product source is unchanged; this commit adds only the isolated correctness kit and unique unfiltered workflow.
